description: Use this when you want to find side bets to make. The competitions' side markets trading now or with a trading window still ahead (GET /api/markets), soonest deadline first: each with its competition (slug, title, status, deadline), status (off: betting is turned on and the operator has yet to open the market on chain; pending; trading), trading_now (a window is open now: buys land only inside one), sells_now and sells_until (a holder can sell now, inside a window or between windows, until sells_until, the moment the competition's result is public; null: no live race, until its results are published), window (the one open now) and next_window (the next to open), each {kind: bounty or race, from, until}, leader (the entry with the highest YES price: outcome_id, label, which is its entrant's '@handle', entrant, their handle and picture, yes_ppm, yes_cents; get_market's entry.name is the entry's own name, and a bet is on that one entry, never on the user), entries (how many entries are listed and live), volume_base_units and market (its route). A side market is a competition's market in real USDC on Solana, one YES/NO pair per entry: a YES share of an entry pays 1 USDC if that entry wins the competition, a NO share 1 USDC if it does not. A competition's own answer names its market too (get_competition's side_bets: its windows, status and trading_now; null where it has none). Read one with get_market. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor, for the next page (keep the other arguments the same)

name: list_markets
title: List side markets
